description: Guild channel only: joining a guild and guildmates talking about what they are doing (any non-reply situation).

lines.text: Thanks for the invite. Proud to wear the {guild} colors.
Happy to be part of {guild}. Shout if you need a {class}.
Evening, {guild}. Anyone need a hand with anything?
All good here. Just finishing up a few pulls.
Just hit {level}, guild! Training first, then back out.
Guild, the muster for {raid} is on. Who is going?
Guild, we are hitting {keep}. Come along if you are free.
Thanks for having me, {guild}. I will try not to pull the whole room.
Just joined {guild} and I already feel at home. Hello all!
Greetings, {guild}. Where do you all usually hunt?
Glad to be here. Who do I talk to about the guild rules?
Evening everyone, new recruit reporting in.
Hail, {guild}! A {class} at your service.
Just signed the charter. A warm hello to all of you.
Wearing the {guild} tag with pride from today.
Hi guild, thanks for the invite! Still learning the ropes.
Nice to meet you all. I am mostly around in the evenings.
Thank you for the welcome. Anyone need a hand in {zone}?
Good to finally be part of {guild}. Long time coming.
Fair warning, I die a lot. Cheerfully, though.
New face here. Happy to group whenever you need a {class}.
Thanks for the tag! I will try to live up to it.
Joined up at last. Greetings from {zone}, guild.
Proud day. {guild} it is, then.
Heya all. Do we have a guild emblem I should put on my cloak?
Greetings, friends. I bring a strong arm and a weak sense of direction.
Thank you, {guild}. I promise to roll fair on the loot.
Is there a usual meeting spot in town, guild?
Glad to join. My last guild went quiet, so this is a nice change.
Hi everyone, {level} {class} here. Point me at something.
Thanks for the invite. Who else is around my level?
I hear {guild} is the finest company in {realm}. Glad to be in it.
Reporting for duty. What does {guild} need most right now?
This guild chat is already livelier than my old one.
Hail all, honoured to be counted among you.
I can fetch, carry, and occasionally fight. Pleased to meet you.
A new banner over my head. Well met, {guild}!
Happy to help anyone gather crafting materials, guild.
Evening, guild. Just glad to have people to adventure with.
Is it true {guild} goes to Darkness Falls together? Count me in.
I will be the one asking silly questions, guild. You have been warned.
Somebody tell me who the officers are so I can behave.
Happy to be here. May {realm} stand forever.
Heh, finally have a guild tag. Hello all!
Joining {guild} feels like coming home after a long road.
Do not worry, {guild}. My pet bites enemies, not guildmates.
Hail, {guild}! Fresh from Camelot and ready to work.
Skal, {guild}! Glad to stand with you for Midgard.
Well met, {guild}. Tir na Nog never felt friendlier.
Evening all. Quiet night in {zone}?
Anyone else just standing around admiring the scenery?
Who is on tonight? I could use some company.
Is it just me or is {zone} extra busy today?
Been sorting my vault for ages and I still cannot find anything.
Anyone up for something? I am free for a while.
Heading to {destination}. Anybody want to tag along?
Taking a breather. Fighting {target} all day wears you down.
Quiet in guild tonight. Everyone out killing things?
Guild, what are we all up to?
Just finished a long run. My feet hate me.
Remember when we all wiped to that one spider? Good times.
Still not over the time someone pulled the whole camp. You know who you are.
Honestly, guild chat is the best part of my day.
Back from a long hunt and ready for gossip.
Does anyone know a good spot for my level around {zone}?
Someone should write a song about our last wipe.
Pretty sure the guards in town are starting to recognise me.
My bags are full of things I will never use. As usual.
Who wants to hear about the bear that chased me for a mile?
Just watched the sun set over {zone}. Not bad at all.
Things are peaceful for once. Enjoy it while it lasts.
Keep an eye out, guild. I hear {enemyrealm} has been busy lately.
Is anyone else's armor squeaking, or is it just mine?
I keep running into the same wolf. We have a relationship now.
Are we meeting up tonight, or just standing around in town again?
Best thing about this guild? Nobody yells at you for dying.
I have been on the road so long I forgot what a bed looks like.
Resting near the bindstone. Wake me if anything exciting happens.
How do you all stay so cheerful after a wipe?
Need a few more people to help clear {target} later, if anyone is free.
On my way to {destination}, then I am free.
Good to see so many names online tonight.
Who has the most deaths this week? I think it is me again.
Bored enough to reorganise my bags. Somebody save me.
Found a nice quiet spot to rest. Anyone nearby?
Missed you all. The road gets lonely.
Any plans for the weekend? I am thinking Darkness Falls.
Our guild has the best-looking cloaks in {realm}. I said it.
Listening to the birds in {zone}. Then something tried to eat me.
To every healer in this guild: thank you. You do not hear it enough.
Could swear the merchants raise their prices when they see our tag.
Anyone else feel like {enemyrealm} is up to something?
Just back from the frontier. Peaceful out there, for once.
My mana bar and I are not on speaking terms tonight.
Sneaking around {zone} all day. Nobody saw me, which is the point.
Arrows are getting low again. Note to self: buy more.
Tanks of the guild, unite. Our shields are dented and proud.
My pet just wandered off after a rabbit. I may be a while.
Lower levels, do not be shy about asking for help. We were all there once.
Stuck in the twenties. It is a long road, isn't it?
Old timers, what was the toughest fight you ever had?
Back in Camelot for a bit. The market is busy tonight.
Anyone else think the Avalon Marsh smells worse than usual?
Anyone hunting the Black Mountains? It is getting crowded.
Jordheim is lovely this time of year. Cold, but lovely.
Mularn is packed with fresh faces again. Good to see.
Trolls of the guild, I think the ale in Jordheim is getting watered down.
Tir na Nog is crowded tonight. Took me ages to reach my vault.
Anyone else love the glow over Lough Derg at night?
The roads around Mag Mell are full of new faces again.
Same here, just taking it easy.
Ha, I know that feeling.
Count me in if anything comes up.
Busy with a few pulls, but I am listening.
Not much going on here either.
Sounds about right.
Story of my life, honestly.
Around if you need me, as always.
Give me a moment and I will join you.
Agreed. Things have been oddly quiet.
You are not alone in that.
Truer words were never spoken.
Doing well, thanks. Hope your night is going better than mine.
Fighting {target} at the moment, but I will be free soon.
Off to {destination} first, then I can help.
Can confirm. Same thing happened to me last week.
I will drink to that.
Busy hunting, but I hear you.
Not a bad idea at all.
Evening! Just back from the road.
Heh, every single time.
Right there with you.
Tell me more, I am only resting anyway.
Nothing clever to add, but hello.
That sounds like our guild, all right.
Hunting {target} in {zone} if anyone wants to join.
{target} keeps dropping junk. Still hunting, though.
Out after {target}. Slow going, but it adds up.
Anyone near {zone}? Could use a friend out here.
Good camp in {zone}. Nobody else around, for once.
Hunting solo for a bit. Holler if you need me.
These {target} hit harder than they look, guild.
Grinding away. My experience bar barely moves.
Clearing {target} out of {zone}. The locals will thank me.
Just pulled two by accident. Survived. Barely.
Careful in {zone}, guild. The wanderers here are nasty.
Running low on potions out here. Should have stocked up.
My pet is doing all the work again. I just point.
Picking them off one arrow at a time.
Quiet hunting tonight. Just me and {target}.
Our group is camping {target} in {zone}. Good experience if anyone wants in.
Group is rolling nicely, guild. Steady pulls.
We are chewing through {target}. Room for one more.
Our healer is holding the whole group together. Hats off.
Group needs a puller. Anyone free?
Just wiped the group. Regrouping at the bindstone.
Good group tonight. Nobody has died yet. Do not jinx it.
We could use another healer in our group if anyone is on.
Grouped with some fine folk out in {zone}. Experience is flowing.
Anyone want to group? I am {level} and bored.
Looking for a group. {level} {class}, can do my job.
Anyone hunting near my level? Would love a group.
LFG, guild. Anything at all, I am not picky.
Need one more for {target}. Any takers in guild?
Free {class} looking for work. Will heal for food.
Anyone want to duo for a while?
Is anyone forming up tonight? I am around.
Seeking company to hunt {target}. It goes faster with friends.
I can come once I finish this pull.
Where are you exactly? I will head over.
Watch the adds, they wander in from behind.
Careful, that camp bites back.
Good luck out there. Save some for the rest of us.
Give me a few minutes, I am on my way.
Sounds like a good spot. Enjoy it.
I would join, but I am deep in {zone} right now.
Hunting {target} myself, or I would come.
Sounds good. Keep me in mind for later.
Already grouped, sorry. Ask again later.
Pull slow and you will be fine.
Bring extra potions, trust me.
Shout if it goes badly, I am close.
Let me finish here and I am yours.
Ding! {level} at last, guild.
Guild, just made {level}. Off to the trainer.
{level}! Took long enough.
Another level down. {level} and climbing.
Hit {level} tonight. Celebrating with a rest by the fire.
Finally {level}! Thanks to everyone who grouped with me.
New level, new spells to fumble.
Level {level}, and my armor is now officially too weak for me.
{level}! Time to spend some fresh training points.
Guild, I dinged. That is all. Carry on.
Made it to {level}. The road gets steeper from here.
Just dinged {level} in {zone}. Feeling good.
Fifty! I can hardly believe it. Thank you all, truly.
Twenty at last. Halfway there, or so they say.
Ding {level}. Darkness Falls, here I come.
{level} reached. Off to spend my points wisely, for once.
I leveled! Somebody stop me before I spend my points badly.
Dinged while running away. Still counts.
Up to {level}. My pet seems more excited than I am.
One more level for {guild}. {level} and proud.
Leveled up, and my sword arm feels stronger already.
Grats! Well earned.
Gratz! Onward and upward.
Nicely done, congratulations.
Congrats! Do not spend all those points at once.
Woo, well done!
Grats, the next one comes faster. Or so they say.
Well done! Drinks are on you.
Congratulations! Keep it up.
Ding! Grats from {zone}.
{raid} is forming, guild. Who is in?
Signing up for {raid}. Anyone else from the guild coming?
Let us show the realm how {guild} does a great hunt.
{raid} tonight! Get repaired, guild.
Anyone else going to {raid}? Would be nice to stick together.
Heading to the muster now. Save me a spot.
I hear {raid} needs healers. Any of ours free?
Big hunt forming. Grab your best gear, guild.
Count me in for {raid}. Wanted to try this one for ages.
Guild, stick close at the muster so we end up in the same group.
{boss} is up! Guild, stay close and stay alive.
Here we go, guild. {boss} does not look friendly.
Watch your health on {boss}, guild.
Spread out, guild. Do not bunch up near {boss}.
That is one big {boss}. I may need a moment.
Healers, keep the tanks standing. We are counting on you.
{boss} just hit me so hard I saw stars.
Everyone focus. This is the big one.
We did it, guild! {raid} is done.
Victory! Proud of every one of you.
{raid} cleared. {guild} represented well tonight.
What a fight. Guild, that was brilliant.
Down it goes! Grats all.
Nobody from the guild died. A miracle.
Loot or no loot, that was a great night.
Well fought, guild. Let us do that again soon.
Repairing first, then on my way.
Count me in.
I will be there shortly.
Grabbing extra potions on the way.
Stay calm, follow the call.
Adds on the left, watch it!
Holding steady here.
Healing as fast as I can!
Grats everyone!
Well done, all.
Great teamwork tonight.
That was a good one. Proud of us.
Guild, we are pushing {keep}. Rams up!
Siege at {keep}. Come help us knock on the door.
The gates of {keep} are cracking. Need more hands.
Bring your siege skills to {keep}, guild.
Keep your heads down near the walls, the oil hurts.
Taking {keep} tonight, guild. Who is with us?
Archers on the walls at {keep}. Watch yourselves.
We need healers at the ram, guild.
Emain Macha calls, guild. Meet us at {keep}.
{keep} is under attack! Everyone who can, come.
{enemyrealm} is hitting {keep}. We need defenders, guild.
Holding the line at {keep}. Send help.
They are on the walls at {keep}. Hurry, guild.
Oil is hot and ready. Let them come.
Our keep needs us, guild. {keep}, now.
Defending {keep}. Their rams will not last long.
Hurry to Hadrian's Wall, guild. They are pushing {keep}.
Gather at Odin's Gate, guild. {keep} needs us.
{keep} is ours! Well fought, guild.
We held {keep}! Proud of you all.
Victory for {realm}! Guild, that was glorious.
{enemyrealm} ran home in a hurry. Good work, guild.
{keep} taken. Our banner flies over it now.
The lord of {keep} has fallen. Drinks in the courtyard, guild!
Not one {enemyrealm} left standing. Well done, guild.
What a fight. Somebody repair my shield.
We lost {keep}. Regroup and we will take it back.
{enemyrealm} had the numbers tonight. Next time.
Fall back, guild. We cannot hold.
Lost {keep}. Chin up, it is not the last fight.
Well, that went badly. Back to the portal keep.
They got us this time. Rest up, guild.
{keep} fell, but they paid dearly for every stone.
Bound and grumpy. They will not hold {keep} for long.
On my way, hold on.
Coming as fast as I can.
Right behind you.
Heading to {keep} now.
Hold the line, I am almost there!
Rams first, then glory.
Healers stay back, I will cover you.
Grats, guild. Well fought.
That one will be sung about.
We will get them next time.
Good fight anyway. Heads up, all.
I needed that rest anyway. Next time, {keep}.
Grinding my crafting skill tonight. Wish me luck.
Crafting again. My hands are sore from all this hammering.
Another failed combine. The forge hates me.
Any other crafters in the guild? I could use some tips.
Just made my best piece yet. Feeling proud.
Spent hours at the forge tonight. Worth it.
Crafting is slow, but I like the quiet.
Making arrows for myself between hunts.
Anyone need {item}? Found it on my travels.
Selling off some junk. Bags are bursting.
Anyone want to trade? I have {item} spare.
Merchants are robbing me blind today.
Looking to swap a few things before I head out, guild.
Picked up {item}. No idea who uses it.
Good luck at the forge.
Ha, the forge hates everyone.
Nice work, keep at it.
I might be interested, let me check my bags.
Ask the guild crafters, they know best.
Not right now, but thanks.
